VOID if any falsifier has fired: payment-network net revenue per $ of GDV below 16bp two consecutive years; payment-network rebates above 55% of gross network fees; a law, regulation or decision capping or setting Mastercard's own network fees in the US, EU or UK; a US credit routing mandate enacted; GDV growing slower than Visa's total nominal volume two consecutive years while the operating margin before provisions falls; a litigation or settlement loss above $5bn in a year, a settlement-guarantee loss above $1bn, another year of buybacks above owner earnings funded by net new debt, or a purchase above $5bn. SUSPENDED if a merger agreement or tender offer naming Mastercard as target is filed. Re-derive on the FY2026 10-K (about February 2027). Source: Test Runs/2026-09-28 Run - MA Mastercard.md.
